units.source_text: 入室就寝之后，还是念念不忘藤壶母后。

en.t: After entering his room and going to bed, he still could not stop thinking of Empress Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 似梦非梦、似醒非醒之间，恍惚看见藤壶母后出现眼前。

en.t: In a state neither fully dreaming nor fully awake, he dimly saw Empress Fujitsubo appear before his eyes.

units.source_text: 她愁容满面，恨恨地言道：“你说决不泄露秘密，然而我们的恶名终于不能隐藏，

en.t: Her face was full of sorrow, and she said bitterly, "You said you would never reveal the secret, yet in the end our disgrace could not be hidden,

units.source_text: 教我在阴间又是羞耻，又是痛苦，我好恨啊！”

en.t: making me suffer shame and anguish even in the world of the dead. How deeply I resent it!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子想回答，然而好像着了梦魇，说不出话，只是呻吟。

en.t: Prince Genji tried to answer, but it was as though he were caught in a nightmare; he could not speak and only groaned.

units.source_text: 紫姬怪道：“哎呀，你为什么？怎么样了？”

en.t: Lady Murasaki asked in alarm, "Oh, what is the matter with you? What has happened?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子醒来，不见了藤壶母后，非常可惜。

en.t: Prince Genji awoke, and when Empress Fujitsubo was nowhere to be seen, he felt a deep sense of loss.
His thoughts were in turmoil, and he did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 努力隐忍，不觉两泪夺眶而出，后来竟濡湿了枕袖。

en.t: He struggled to hold himself back, but before he knew it tears spilled from his eyes, eventually soaking his pillow sleeve.

units.source_text: 紫姬弄得莫名其妙，百般慰问，源氏公子只是一动不动地躺着，后来吟道：

en.t: Lady Murasaki was utterly bewildered and tried in every way to comfort and question him, but Prince Genji only lay motionless, and at last recited:
